transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I called EAP because I’ve been jumping really hard at little noises in the office—like a file drawer closing or somebody dropping a mug. My chest starts racing, and it takes a lot longer than it seems like it should to settle down.
Did these reactions start after a specific frightening or traumatic event?
Yeah. It started about two weeks ago, after this late-night confrontation with my regional boss.
During that confrontation, did you feel that your physical safety or your life was in danger?
I’m not sure what you mean exactly. I know it was a really upsetting confrontation, but I can’t say I thought my life was in danger.
Before that confrontation two weeks ago, were you frequently dealing with excessive worry or anxiety about daily matters?
I don’t know. I hadn’t really noticed anything like that before.
Have you been experiencing unwanted, upsetting memories or vivid flashbacks of the confrontation?
I haven’t really noticed memories or flashbacks coming up like that.
